name: Lauryl aminopropylglycine
description: Lauryl aminopropylglycine (CAS 34395-72-7 ) is an amphoteric surfactant combining a long-chain fatty amine with a glycine head group. It delivers effective surface-active performance across both rinse-off personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. The chemical functions primarily as a cleanser, emulsifier, and wetting agent. In personal care, it is used in shampoos, body washes, and facial cleansers where mild yet effective foaming and skin compatibility are required. Industrial and institutional cleaning formulations incorporate it for degreasing hard surfaces. Its amphoteric character supports performance across a range of pH conditions, making it a versatile choice for various detergent systems. Textile and leather processing operations use it as a wetting and dispersing agent. This helps to improve substrate penetration during critical dyeing, finishing, and treatment steps within the manufacturing cycle. In paper manufacturing, it supports surface modification and fiber dispersion during processing stages. This ensures consistent quality and performance of the final paper products across different industrial applications. Lauryl aminopropylglycine is typically supplied as a liquid or aqueous solution. Concentration levels vary by manufacturer and application requirement, allowing for flexibility in formulation and production processes. Both technical-grade and cosmetic-grade material are available in the market. Cosmetic grades are subject to purity and safety documentation standards relevant to personal care registration and regulatory compliance. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBCs to meet industrial demand. Manufacturers ensure that the material meets specific quality benchmarks to maintain consistency across different batches and global supply chains.
